subject: Warning message: package ‘sqldf’ is not available (for R version 3.0.2)

messages.author: 9d387ac609eeb9d1
messages.subject: Warning message: package ‘sqldf’ is not available (for R version 3.0.2)
parts:
Hello,
I try to install the sqldf package on R that runs under Ubuntu 14.04 LTS. As follows:

install.packages("sqldf")

And get this:

Installing package into ‘/home/ewm/R/i686-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.0’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
Warning message:
package ‘sqldf’ is not available (for R version 3.0.2)

Do I need to use a previous R version in this case?

or

Do I need to install another package before install "sqldf"?

Any comment or suggestion is wellcome,

Thank you,

Hugo

messages.author: 17e30776ec2a7fb1
messages.subject: Re: Warning message: package ‘sqldf’ is not available (for R version 3.0.2)
parts:
sqldf 0.4-10 requires R 3.1.0 or later.  See the Depends and Imports lines here:
http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/sqldf/index.html 

Note that if you want to revert to an older version of all packages 
you could use the checkpoint package to revert your installation 
as discussed in the Latest News on the sqldf home page.
